The '''Republic Seal Mountain''' was a [[mountain]] on the [[moon]] [[Iktotch]]. When the citizens of the moon [[Precognition|predicted]] the arrival of the [[scout]]s sent out by the [[Galactic Republic]], the Iktotchi realized that cementing their position in the galactic community would benefit their own position in the galaxy. Carving the [[Republic crest]] into the face of the mountain, the Iktotchi knew that the Republic [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] would be intrigued and pleased by the act of welcome and invited the Iktotchi to join the Republic.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>
